description: Use inverse folding models (ProteinMPNN, ESM-IF) as efficient energy oracles that approximate the free energy landscape. Recent work shows inverse folding log-likelihoods have a direct free-energy interpretation. Combine sequence-based (ESM-2) and structure-based (ProteinMPNN) scores as complementary views for robust multi-mutant scoring.
mathematical_formalization: For structure X and sequence s: ddG(mut) ~ -kT * [log P(s_mut|X) - log P(s_wt|X)]. Combined oracle: ddG_combined = w_1 * ddG_ESM2 + w_2 * ddG_MPNN + w_3 * ddG_ESM2 * ddG_MPNN, weights learned from Mega-scale data.
analogical_connections: Ensemble methods in ML: combining weak learners
SPURS (Li & Luo 2025) rewires PLM + inverse folding for stability prediction
Free energy perturbation in molecular dynamics
Multi-view learning: sequence and structure views
implementation_hypothesis: Load ESM-2 and ProteinMPNN on GPU. Compute masked marginal and conditional probability. Linearly combine with calibrated weights. Add pairwise interaction correction. ~5ms per variant on A100.
experiment_seed: Train combination weights on 80% Mega-scale single mutants, test on 20%. Compare ESM-2 alone, ProteinMPNN alone, linear combo, combo with interactions. Evaluate on FireProtDB multi-mutants.
